 Wedgewood Pharmacy Recall
 We have been made aware of a product recall by Wedgewood Pharmacy LLC, a commonly used veterinary drug compounding company, regarding certain compounded veterinary medications that may have either increased or decreased amounts of medication in them than prescribed / labelled.
 The risks to veterinary patients receiving these preparations include lack of treatment effectiveness for those receiving preparations with inappropriately low drug concentrations and toxicity for those receiving preparations that contain inappropriately high drug concentrations.
 Affected products were shipped between February 18 and October 6, 2026, and a complete list of products affected (with lot numbers and expiration dates of affected preparations) is available at: Recall Lookup .
 Wedgewood has posted resources for owners seeking information about this development on their Pharmacy Recall Client Information Site at: Expert Inquiry .
 They have also provided a portal for veterinary professionals and pharmacies seeking information about this recall at: Professional Recall Lookup .
 If you are currently administering an affected drug preparation to your dog, you are advised to refrain from giving any more, to retain the product, and to contact Wedgewood’s recall services at 866-562-5931 between 8 a.m. and 9 p.m. ET from Monday through Friday or between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET on Saturday. You should also contact your veterinarian with any concerns regarding a potentially affected product promptly.
 The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is aware of this situation and has posted an announcement at: FDA Announcement .
 Wedgewood has engaged and is fully cooperating with Sedgewick, a global leader in the coordination of such product recalls, to address this important issue as quickly and effectively as possible.
 This page was last updated on Monday, Oct 26, 2026
